products.name: Crescent Rose
products.short: Three forms. One prop. Animated Scythe, Gun and compact Pack modes for your PCVR avatar.
products.long: A transforming VRChat avatar prop with connected mechanical animations, lower-back storage and right-hand deployment. Includes VRCFury integration, mode icons, a visibility toggle and setup instructions. Requires a compatible humanoid avatar, VRChat SDK and VRCFury installed separately. Fit the pack and hand alignment to your avatar in Unity. Personal avatar use only; no redistribution or resale. Avatar not included.
specs: PCVR / Windows only — no standalone Quest or Android
VRChat SDK, VRCFury and a compatible humanoid avatar
Personal avatar use; no redistribution or resale

products.name: Aesthetic Gift Basket
products.short: Cursed decor prop pack. Wholesome gift basket, absolutely unhinged contents.
products.long: A decorative gift basket for VRChat worlds and avatars, filled with things nobody would actually gift. Built for PC and Quest, delivered as a unitypackage you drop straight into your project.
specs: Basket plus contents as separate prefabs
